item.title: 4-year-old child hospitalized after being struck in head by bottle reportedly thrown from float during Zulu parade
item.description: A 4-year-old child is still recovering after reportedly being struck in the head with a glass bottle thrown from a float during the Krewe of Zulu parade.

item.title: US advances to Olympic men's hockey semifinals with 2-1 OT victory over Sweden
item.description: The U.S. and Canada are moving on to the semifinals at the Olympics. Each needed extra hockey to get through the quarterfinals.

item.title: Juvenile critically injured after being hit on South Flannery Road in Baton Rouge
item.description: A juvenile was hit by a vehicle on South Flannery Road in Baton Rouge and transported in critical condition.

item.title: Multiple tornadoes confirmed in south Louisiana, southwest Mississippi
item.description: A tornado touched down along the Tangipahoa–St. Tammany Parish line early Sunday morning.

item.title: Shooting in north Baton Rouge sends one to hospital, officials confirm
item.description: Authorities are investigating a shooting that took place in north Baton Rouge on Wednesday evening.

item.title: Baton Rouge Weather: Winter makes a return late weekend
item.description: BATON ROUGE, La. (Louisiana First) — Enjoy the warmth for now, because winter will make a return by Sunday. item.title: Nottoway Plantation owner details plan to rebuild after fire while recalling sadness, backlash
item.description: The owner is working towards a "new Nottoway" with a planned rebuild to include recognition of the contribution of slaves to the plantation.

item.title: Washington Street Exit on I-10 in Baton Rouge to permanently close
item.description: An exit along I-10, used by generations of Baton Rouge drivers, is officially being removed, marking a major change for commuters who rely on the Washington Street ramp.

item.title: Louisiana Sen. Regina Barrow talks minimum wage, insurance in pre-session town hall meeting
item.description: State Sen. Regina Barrow (D-La.) is touring her district to discuss topics ranging from senior support to the state's minimum wage and cost of living, emphasizing the importance of direct communication with her constituents.

item.title: Class to resume Thursday after power outage at Westdale Middle School
item.description: The East Baton Rouge Parish School System has given the all-clear for students at Westdale Middle Magnet School to resume class on Thursday following a total power outage on Wednesday.
